items.title: Every Soulsborne Game, Ranked From Worst to Best
items.content:
elden ring Image via FromSoftware By Robert Lee III Published Aug 13, 2026, 6:36 AM EDT Writing from the Chicagoland area in Illinois, Robert is an avid movie watcher and will take just about any excuse to find time to go to his local movie theaters. Robert graduated from Bradley University with degrees in Journalism and Game Design with a minor in Film Studies. Robert tries his best to keep up with all the latest movie releases, from those released in theaters to those released on streaming. While he doesn't always keep up with the latest TV shows, he makes it a goal to watch nearly every major new release possible. He has been honing his craft and following any and all movie news all his life, leading up to now, where he has a vast knowledge of film and film history. He also logs every movie that he watches on his Letterboxd page, and has hosted a weekly online movie night with his closest friends for over 6 years. Sign in to your Collider account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap In a medium as old as video games are now, most of the time you can say you’ve seen it all. However, when Demon’s Souls was originally released back in 2009, it unleashed upon the world a new type of game that, to this day, remains one of the most influential of the past decade. Beyond the memes of “git gud," the core gameplay, environmental design, and storytelling techniques behind the Soulsborne games keep fans coming back time and time again.

With FromSoftware continuing to expand its catalog beyond the traditional Souls formula, it seems like a good time to revisit and rank the games in the Soulsborne series, while also taking a look at the closely connected titles such as Bloodborne and Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice . The games are ranked based on the strength of their combat, world and level design, bosses, atmosphere, innovation, and overall influence on the Soulsborne formula.

A still from Dark Souls 2 Image via Bandai Namco Games This shouldn’t come as that big of a surprise to anyone who’s played through all of the Soulsborne series. Though it has its fair share of fans, Dark Souls II is still far and away the worst game in the series . While the game would tighten up some areas that it was otherwise lacking in the original release with the remaster Scholar of the First Sin , the end result is still a slog to get through at times.

But with all the negatives that do surround the game, the worst Soulsborne game is still much better than a lot of other titles in the genre. There are a number of truly memorable environments included, as well as some great music (the Majula theme is arguably the best hub theme in the entire series). However, you can really tell that with series creator Hidetaka Miyazaki working primarily on Bloodborne , Dark Souls II was definitely missing something.

Image via Sony Computer Entertainment Unlike the games that will follow on this list, the quality gap between Dark Souls II and Demon’s Souls is a rather large one. When playing Demon’s Souls , it’s clear from the outset that this is the first attempt at something that will no doubt be refined as it continues. Because of that, there are a lot of small speed bumps that might leave you scratching your head if you’re playing it for the first time after already playing other entries in the series. There’s a great case to be made that, with the Bluepoint Games remake available on the PS5, it’s actually a perfect place to jump into the series for newcomers. You’ll often hear Souls veterans state that the first game you play in the series will be the one that you’ll think is the hardest, but even by that standard, Demon’s Souls is still one of the easier games in the franchise .

You’ll see certain gameplay mechanics present, like consumable healing items that don’t refill, that were partially implemented into Dark Souls II but would primarily make their return in Bloodborne . Because of that, you might be finding yourself farming some grass to make things easier on yourself. One of the biggest draws of these games is also the boss fights , and much like other aspects, you can see the idea present here in its infancy, fully realized in later games. There are your typical FromSoftware boss battles, such as the brute Flamelurker, and also traces of more abstract boss designs, like the Dragon God. There's also the expertly presented Maiden Astraea fight, which remains one of the most effective thematically presented boss battles in the entire Souls series. Though it's not near the #1 spot on this list, Demon's Souls is still worth playing, and a great blueprint of what the series would later become.

A still from Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice Image via Activision Picking up with the fast combat nature that Bloodborne succeeded with, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice was an interesting departure from the typical Souls -like format. Though the unorthodox approach to storytelling in FromSoftware’s games is one of its most intriguing aspects, Sekiro decided to look at it from a more familiar narrative-driven angle . The end result is more welcoming to those that might have otherwise been put off by the often cryptic nature of their previous titles, which would often leave players sorting through lore in the game's menus as part of item descriptions.

A lot of the problems that people have with Sekiro stem from its more restricted nature. Though Sekiro himself has various tools that he can utilize in and out of combat, you’re restricted to one weapon. For many people, much of the fun of the Soulsborne games is the experimentation with the various weapon types, and in Sekiro that’s completely absent. With that being said, this is some of the finest combat in any FromSoftware title. When Nioh was released two years before, it left some people yearning for that type of refined, quick-paced style of combat, and Sekiro delivers heavily on that front. The fast-paced, oftentimes multiple-phased boss battles are thrilling to take part in. It's a game that rewards patience as well as aggressiveness, as mechanics like parrying act as your key to survival.

A tarnished kneeling on the ground while holding a sword in their hand in art for 'Elden Ring Nightreign' (2025) Image via FromSoftware Elden Ring Nightreign is easily the most unique entry in the franchise, acting as a complementary experience as opposed to a true continuation of the previous release. This Elden Ring spinoff instead implements a roguelike style of gameplay, with an emphasis on repeating a cycle of runs and using gained knowledge to make it farther on each attempt. This is further complemented by Nightreign being the only Soulsborne game that is envisioned as a co-op experience, built and designed for a group of three players to traverse Limveld and prepare themselves for Heolstor, the Nightlord.

Because of the inherent facets of the roguelike genre and the implementation of multiplayer, Nightreign finds itself to be arguably the most infinitely replayable experience in the entire Soulsborne franchise . It seamlessly acts as an entertaining and fulfilling companion piece to the world and overall experience of Elden Ring , creating something incredibly fulfilling without taking away any of the strengths of the original game. There will always be an inherent fun in playing through the game with friends and fighting against giant, difficult bosses together, as sharing the glory of Soulsborne gameplay in co-op is a must for any fans of the series.

Your answers point to the world your instincts were built for. This is the universe your temperament, your survival instincts, and your particular brand of stubbornness were made for.

You took the red pill a long time ago — probably before anyone offered it to you. You're a systems thinker who can't help but notice the seams in things.

The wasteland doesn't reward the clever or the well-connected — it rewards those who are hard to kill and harder to break. That's you.

You'd survive here because you know how to exist in moral grey areas without losing yourself completely.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Receives Pre-Release Trailer
Before Elden Ring launches on Switch 2 this month beat Lies of P first
items.summary: No word of a lie, it's worth your time.
items.content:
Lies of P is out now on the Nintendo Switch 2 and it deserves its flowers. Elden Ring will be great, but this is the souls game to play.

Nintendo Switch 2 owners are counting down the days until Elden Ring finally launches on the console.

It’s been many months in the making as the Elden Ring port was delayed from 2025 to this year, but will finally launch on August 28.

Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition will include the full game, plus DLC, and some new cosmetics/starter classes, which will be available as paid content packs for other platforms.

Before embarking on another quest to become Elden Lord though, consider a different souls game you can play right now on your Nintendo Switch 2, Lies of P . We’d even argue it’s better than Elden Ring in some regards.

After launching in September 2023, Lies of P has acquired quite a large fanbase, but it’s nowhere near as popular as FromSoftware’s work. Hopefully, the recently released Nintendo Switch 2 port will see it garner some new supporters, and you should be one of them.

Lies of P: Complete Edition , much like Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition , is the full game plus the DLC expansion Overture .

Combined, that’s over 55 hours of gameplay according to HowLongToBeat , if you plan on doing side-content.

My own playthroughs on the Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5 ran flawlessly and I was delighted to see the Nintendo Switch 2 version be just as good.

It felt like there was little to no sacrifice in terms of performance or visual quality despite being on Nintendo’s hardware. It just felt like good ol’ Lies of P, but this time I could take it on the go.

Bloodborne fans will get a kick out of it instantly because it’s a game that rewards a bolder playstyle. After taking damage, you can replenish a bit of your health by striking your opponent, so trading blows becomes a high-risk, high-reward strategy for melting bosses.

Lies of P will give you just as much of a challenge as some of FromSoftware’s work, and I’d argue that the Overture expansion is actually harder at times. However, if you’d rather just experience the story, past updates added difficulty modes that’ll make life a bit easier.

Elden Ring remains one of my favourite games and while I’m excited to play it on the Nintendo Switch 2 later this month, Lies of P’s re-release got me more excited.

As good as Elden Ring is, I’ve always felt its scale to have diminishing returns on repeat playthroughs. Unless I’m feeling committed, riding around the map to collect items I want for my build starts to feel like I’m shopping rather than playing a game.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition: Story Spotlight
items.summary: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition arrives August 28 on Switch 2. See what the new Story Spotlight reveals about the journey, expansion and new content.
items.content:
Join Opinion Network Advertise Contact Search Mobile AI Apps Gaming Computing Mobile AI Apps Gaming Computing More + Aug 12, 2026, 5:09 PM IST Disclaimer: We may earn a commission if you make any purchase by clicking our links. Please see our detailed guide here .

Bandai Namco has released a fresh Story Spotlight for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition, leaning heavily into the game’s dark fantasy atmosphere and the journey through the Lands Between ahead of its Nintendo Switch 2 release.

Shared by Bandai Namco US on August 11, the new promotional video goes back to the fractured and desolate Lands Between, bringing players back to the mysterious world that awaits the Tarnished. The post asks players to think about how they will make their way toward the Elden Throne as they follow the lingering guidance of Grace.

This latest spotlight puts the game’s narrative atmosphere at the center, rather than focusing only on technical details or the Nintendo Switch 2 version itself.

At the heart of Elden Ring, there is the Lands Between, a huge fantasy realm shaped by conflict, ambition, and the destruction that followed the shattering of the Elden Ring.

Players step into the role of a Tarnished, an exiled figure who returns to the Lands Between after the guidance of Grace calls them back. The end goal is to face the powers controlling the broken world and pursue the road that leads to becoming the next Elden Lord.

Nintendo’s official description frames it similarly, around a world left shattered by the Shattering, a conflict connected to the demigod children of Queen Marika. The Tarnished then explore the Lands Between, uncover its secrets, and ultimately seek the throne.

That whole setup is one big reason the new Story Spotlight works well as a promotional piece for the Tarnished Edition. Instead of presenting the game as simply another Switch 2 port, the video underlines the scale and mystery of the adventure itself.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition is officially set to release worldwide on August 28, 2026, exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2. Bandai Namco has confirmed the release date after the additional development work and performance tuning that went into the Switch 2 version.

The Tarnished Edition is an all-in-one package that combines the original Elden Ring with its major expansion, Shadow of the Erdtree, along with additional content created for the release. If you’re a Nintendo Switch 2 owner and haven’t played the game before, the core journey and major expansion will be included in the same package.

One of the most obvious perks of the Tarnished Edition is that it includes Shadow of the Erdtree, the major expansion that launched for the original game. The expansion pushes players beyond the Lands Between into the Realm of Shadow, adding a new region, enemies, bosses, gear, and story elements that expand what players already know about the world.

Bandai Namco frames the Switch 2 release as covering both the base game and the expansion, making it a complete package aimed at newcomers. This means buyers of the Switch 2 edition won’t need to purchase the original game separately or chase down the expansion on its own.

The Tarnished Edition is more than just a package containing the existing game and expansion. For Nintendo Switch 2 players, it also adds new features, including two new starting classes, four new armor sets, and three customization options for Torrent, the spectral steed ridden by the Tarnished.

The new starting classes bring more ways to begin an adventure, while the additional armor gives players more choices for shaping their character’s appearance and playstyle. Torrent can also receive new cosmetic looks, allowing players to personalize one of the most recognizable companions in the game.

items.title: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Light Greatsword locations
items.summary: Here's our in-progress list of Light Greatsword locations in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.content:
Where to find all Light Greatswords in the Realm of Shadow.

Image credit: Eurogamer/FromSoftware Guide by Kelsey Raynor Senior Guides Writer Additional contributions by Marie Pritchard Published on Aug. 12, 2026, 11:33 a.m. Follow Elden Ring Light Greatswords in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree are swords that have the same length as a Greatsword but have far less weight to them. These Elden Ring weapons are worth collecting, especially if you like to use Greatswords but find yourself wishing they were that bit faster to attack with.

With that in mind, here are all Light Greatsword locations in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree .

Location: At the top of a tower in the early part of Castle Ensis. To get to it, cross the bridge at the front part of the castle then follow the main path up and to the southwest. Finally, climb the wooden stairs to get to the tower.

Skill: 'Impaling Thrust' - Allows you to have piercing armaments that overcome enemy shieldsby lunging forward with a long thrust that can pierce an enemy's guard.

To see this content please enable targeting cookies. Manage cookie settings

Location: Defeat Needle Knight Leda in Enir-llim to gain this weapon from her corpse, alongside her armor.

Skill: Needle Piercer - Generates ten gold needles that pierce the target all at once. Those pierced are purged of ailments and effects. (This includes status efects like Rot and Poison, but also buffs.)

Requirements: 11 Strength, 22 Dexterity, 19 Faith

Location: Exchange Rellana, Twin Moon Knight 's Remembrance at the Roundtable Hold for this weapon.

Skill: Moon-and-Fire Stance - After assuming a readied stance, the swords are imbued with magic. By following up with a normal attack, you'll cast glintstone waves, and by following up with a strong attack, you'll produce a wave of flames around you.

Requirements: 13 Strength, 16 Dexterity, 16 Intelligence, 16 Faith

Before you go about hunting down all three Light Greatswords in Shadow of the Erdtree , I think it's worth mentioning the Ashes of War for these weapons.

Firstly, there is just one Ash of War that can be applied to Great Swords - Wing Stance - which you'll find inside a chest in Castle Ensis. Secondly, this Ash of War can only be applied to the Milady, as it is the only one of the three Light Greatswords available in the game that isn't a Somber weapon.

items.title: FromSoftware Attempted Ray Tracing with Elden Ring, But It Pales in Comparison to Dark Souls 3 with Modded Path Tracing
items.summary: Modder Ganaboy is bringing path tracing to Dark Souls 3 via the DS Lighting Engine, delivering stunning visuals.
items.content:
Although FromSoftware has created some of the best action RPGs of all time, never ceding to the pressure to create more marketable titles , the Japanese studio is not exactly known for pushing the technical boundaries of games. In Elden Ring , the studio led by Hidetaka Miyazaki did try its hand at ray tracing with ray-traced ambient occlusion and shadows, but what it has achieved pales in comparison to the modded path tracing that is coming soon to Dark Souls 3 .

The third entry in the series is getting remastered lighting thanks to modder Ganaboy , who is working on a new version of the DS Lighting Engine mod, which added path tracing to Dark Souls 2 back in April. Although a release date for the new version of the mod has yet to be confirmed, its developer released two work-in-progress videos showcasing the High Wall of Lothric and the Firelink Shrine in path-traced glory.

In addition to sharing the videos above, Ganaboy also shared the system requirements to enjoy Dark Souls 3 with path tracing when it launches. "DS3 Geometry is 10X of DS2, Requirements will be similar to DS2LE, All cards supported for DS2LE will be for DS3 as well. All RTX 2/3 series are supported. You may have to use a slightly higher upscaling. For eg if you used Quality mode in DS2LE. You will probably need to use Balanced for DS3," the modder wrote in the video's description.

Considering how path tracing is generally extremely demanding even in dated games , it's no surprise that upscaling via NVIDIA DLSS will be required to achieve an acceptable level of performance.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Arrives For Switch 2 on August 28
items.summary: The latest trailer for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition shows off all of the content coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28.
items.content:
Posted in: Bandai Namco , Elden Ring , Games , Video Games | Tagged: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition , george r r martin , Hidetaka Miyazaki

The latest trailer for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition shows off all of the content coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28.

Bandai Namco released a new trailer this week, showcasing the Elden Ring Tarnished Edition ahead of its August 28 release on the Nintendo Switch 2 . As you can see in the video above, this edition comes with the base game, the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, and new content, including two new Starting Classes for players to choose from. As well as new character armor and the ability to customize Torrent, your in-game mount that you travel on. Enjoy the trailer ahead of the game's launch in about three weeks.

Journey through the Lands Between, a new fantasy world created by Hidetaka Miyazaki , creator of the influential Dark Souls video game series, and George R. R. Martin , author of The New York Times best-selling fantasy series, A Song of Ice and Fire . Unravel the mysteries of the Elden Ring's power. Encounter adversaries with profound backgrounds, characters with their own unique motivations for helping or hindering your progress, and fearsome creatures.

items.title: Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Pre-order available. Explore a breathtaking world full of excitement and mystery.
items.content:
08/11/26 Pre-order now Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2 The Lands Between—a place of myth, gods, and broken dreams. Long ago, Queen Marika and her divine offspring reigned here, but since the Elden Ring was shattered, the world has fallen into decay. Now, the land whispers for a King.

The “Tarnished,” long exiled, are finally seeing the light of Grace once more. Step into this hauntingly beautiful realm, unravel its ancient mysteries, and rise as the one true Elden Lord.

The ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition game arrives on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on August 28 .

The Lands Between are part of a vast continent, where magnificent open fields and huge dungeons with complex three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. As you explore, the joy of discovering unknown and overwhelming threats awaits you.

Mastery of the terrain and knowledge of its secrets can help you overcome enemies and defeat formidable bosses—or lead invading players into traps.

The founding mythology of Elden Ring was written by George R. R. Martin and adapted into a rich multilayered story. Intersecting goals and desires between the characters create an intense narrative that weaves throughout the Lands Between. The events of the game can unravel in many ways—depending on your interventions.

Combat is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of dexterity. As you seek to become the Elden Lord, you’ll need to explore the balance between attacking, avoiding damage, using a wide variety of weapons, spells, summons, and perfecting your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

In addition to customizing the appearance of your character, there are countless ways to combine the weapons, armor, usable items, and magic that you equip. You can develop your character according to your play style.

No matter if you prefer bold physical confrontation, tactical spellcasting, or the subtle art of stealth, you’ll be able to find gear that supports your choices.

Traverse together with other Nintendo Switch 2 players. You can play with up to two other Tarnished as your cooperative teammates, either by inviting them using a shared password or by summoning them from a pool of nearby community members.

There are also ample opportunities to face off against other players, either through co-op invasions, invited duels, or the many player battle options available in the three Colosseums.

If you’d like to learn more or begin your journey to the Lands Between by pre-ordering the Tarnished Edition, please check out the link below.

items.title: Elden Ring For Switch 2 Is Looking Pretty Slick In New Story Trailer
items.content:
Bandai Namco had released a new story trailer for Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition ahead of its Switch 2 launch on 28th August 2026 .

While we're well aware that publishers like to show off games in their very best light for trailers, there's no denying that it actually looks really nice. After reports of some performance issues during hands-on sessions, it seems FromSoftware has taken the time to make sure it looks and runs well on Nintendo's console.

Obviously, we'll know for sure when we get it in our hands for review. Stay tuned.

Otherwise, the trailer provides a rundown of what to expect from the base game and the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, which is included as standard. It will also receive a Game-Key Card release at retail, with pre-orders granting two additional gestures in-game.

"The Lands Between lie fractured and desolate, yet the faint call of grace lingers within its ruins.

"The path to the Elden Throne lies before you."

Meanwhile, a network test for The Duskbloods will also take place later this month from 21st - 24th August. If you signed up, you will already know by now if you were successful in your application, so be sure to check out our guide for all the info on times and whatnot.

Most of these films have been based on old-school series, like Super Mario Bros. or Sonic the Hedgehog , but some upcoming projects are instead based on newer titles that became instant classics. For example, filming recently wrapped on a live-action adaptation of FromSoftware's 2022 fantasy action game Elden Ring .

The film was directed by Alex Garland, best known for writing the 28 Days Later franchise, and will be distributed by A24. As a grand fantasy epic, Elden Ring will surely be reminiscent of J. R. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings and Peter Jackson's trilogy of film adaptations, but it will also take cues from the eldritch mythos of H. P. Lovecraft. Elden Ring did not have a traditional story structure, so it will be difficult to adapt to the big screen. However, if successful, it will coalesce into a truly unique fantasy experience.

A closeup of Sauron in Mount Doom from The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring Image via New Line Cinema The fascinating worldbuilding of Elden Ring was developed by A Song of Ice and Fire author George R. R. Martin, who will also produce the upcoming film. However, aside from its dark tone, Elden Ring was more akin to The Lord of the Rings than Game of Thrones . In an interview with GamesRadar, co-writer Hidetaka Miyazaki even cited The Lord of the Rings as one of his three main inspirations, alongside The Eternal Champion and RuneQuest .

Elden Ring was much more fantastical than Martin's usual work, featuring an abundance of gods, giant monsters, and spellcasters. There were also more specific parallels to The Lord of the Rings , the most overt being the focus on a golden ring. Unlike the One Ring, the titular artifact of the game was not a piece of jewelry.

Rather, the Elden Ring was a collection of magical runes with the power to dictate the fundamental laws of the universe. For example, prior to the events of the game, Queen Marika the Eternal removed the Destined Death rune from the Elden Ring, rendering it impossible for anyone to die of natural causes.

The Elden Ring was housed within a giant, glowing tree called the Erdtree, calling to mind the holy Two Trees of Valinor from Tolkien's lore . Elden Ring also included several names reminiscent of those from Tolkien's writings. Even Elden Ring 's setting, the Land Between, is practically synonymous with that of The Lord of the Rings , Middle-earth.

According to a 2025 The New Yorker interview, when Garland pitched an Elden Ring adaptation to A24 head Noah Sacco, the latter likened it to Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy. With the proper care and budget, Elden Ring could become the first true successor to those beloved films, which are still heralded as the best in the fantasy genre.

High fantasy is not the only genre that inspired Elden Ring . FromSoftware's games frequently delve into cosmic horror. This was most obvious in Bloodborne, which will also soon receive an adaptation , but it was evident in Elden Ring as well.

items.title: ELDEN RING - RAGING WOLF 1/6 SCALE STATUE
items.summary: Who is the Raging Wolf? Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to
items.content:
Who is the Raging Wolf?

Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to become the shadow of one of the Empyreans and built his strength relentlessly as he traveled through fallow Limgrave to the golden city of Leyndell. And yet in spite of all his strength, his armor is now worn by another… An unnamed Tarnished now walks the Lands Between in the skin of the wolf. Does this warrior seek the same fate as Vargram, forever stalking at the side of an Empyrean? Will they uphold the Golden Order or supplant it for some new code? Whatever the destination, woe befall upon any who dare block the path.

The most impressive Elden Ring statue yet

Standing at 33 cm/13 inches, it’s one of the largest character statues ever produced for ELDEN RING. Crafted with the attentive supervision of FromSoftware, this full 1/6 scale figure captures each minute detail with masterful skill. The size allows perfect fidelity to the beautiful and dark fantasy atmosphere of the game, including smears of bloody red across blade of the Bastard Sword and the crest of the Iron Roundshield. From the intricate filigrees of its helm to its whisps of silvered fur blown back by an errant breeze to the humble, dusty cloth wraps protecting the feet of its greaves against the mossy stones of the path to Stoneveil Castle, it’s a portrait of the implacable will of the Tarnished. All these expertly rendered touches from sculpturer Shinya Yamaoka make this statue a perfect match to the most iconic set from one of the most iconic games of this generation.

Where can I get a Raging Wolf Set statue?

Pre-orders for the Raging Wolf 1/6 scale statue can be placed on the official Bandai Namco website. At this time, based on the production estimates of Gecco studio, these stunning PVC/ABS figures will ship to your home in Winter of 2026. If you are a true aficionado of the game, there is no better purchase to bring the world of Elden Ring to your home or office. It’s a timeless piece for your own collection or an impressive gift for a friend or loved one. And one small note, if you have not yet found this set in the Lands Between for your Tarnished, we recommend you seek the aid of Recusant Bernahl at the Volcano Manor.

Place your order for the Raging Wolf statue on the official Bandai Namco Store.

*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.

items.title: ELDEN RING: SHADOW OF THE ERDTREE – Official Vinyl Soundtrack
items.summary: Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree. Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set
items.content:
Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree.

Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set is crafted for collectors, audiophiles, and Tarnished who seek to experience the Realm of Shadow through its music.

The Collection

Housed in a full color gatefold sleeve and marked with the symbol of Messmer the Impaler, each vinyl disc is pressed on heavyweight material to ensure optimal durability and warmth of playback. Whether displayed proudly on a shelf or played to relive your own quest, this set is designed as both a collector’s piece and a lasting tribute to one of the most celebrated expansions in modern gaming.

The Artists

Across 18 tracks, the soundtrack transforms the ELDEN RING experience into a powerful standalone odyssey—one carried by orchestral grandeur, ethereal choir work, and the signature melancholy that defines the worlds created by FromSoftware.

A Collector’s Treasure

This official vinyl set is an essential centerpiece for any discerning fan’s collection. Perfect for longtime followers of FromSoftware’s musical legacy or newcomers drawn into the Land of Shadow for the first time. *This vinyl is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, Middle East, India and the United States

items.title: Discover the ELDEN RING Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp
items.summary: Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING ’s most iconic character. Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique n
items.content:
Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING’s most iconic character.

Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique night lamp captures the tragic loyalty and silent strength of Blaidd, Shadow of Ranni.

The lamp features an LED-illuminated base that reveals glowing rune symbols beneath Blaidd’s feet, evoking the grace-given power that guides Tarnished across the Lands Between. Rising above it, an engraved acrylic summoning panel glows softly when lit, capturing the look and feel of an in-game summon sign and the spirit-calling magic it represents. Powered through a simple USB connection, it offers effortless illumination for any desk, gaming setup, or collector’s display.

"If ever thou shouldst call upon me… I shall come."

Blaidd’s oath echoes still. Now, he stands ready, not for battle, but as a silent guardian of your space.

Bring the moonlit magic of ELDEN RING into your world, one glowing rune at a time.

*This edition is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia and the United States.
